limits: Fake optimizer and synthetic body-dependent rewards; no model contacted. The full pre-call scan and the sandboxed optimizer host are evidenced by procedure_006. Evaluating a real candidate body through host rollouts is T009 work.
outcome: passed: With the preregistered parameters (beam 2, branch 2, 2 rounds, minibatch 5, 2 hosts, 3 repetitions) APO runs 1 then 2 parents with 2 then 4 children, 9 optimizer calls and 120 rollouts (20 + 40 search, 60 full evaluation of the best), as in the feasibility table; every APO candidate records its parent, round, two call ids, both passed contamination checks and the hash of the critique and edit templates; configuration defaults stop at the 120-rollout cap (unit-cap), configured rounds above 3 are capped at 3, the optimizer-call cap stops the run, and unusable edits are failed calls without candidates. Negative controls: an optimizer outside the runner channel is refused (optimizer-bypass), a non-fake channel is refused until the sandboxed host path exists (isolation-failed), and inputs with a held-out case id or the rollout canary are refused before any call (holdout-contamination).
